title: Rahu Ketu
desc: Ravi, a CBI inspector, goes undercover to a remote town in order to investigate the rising suspicious deaths. However, things become complicated when he gets arrested by the local police.

title: Aasmaan
desc: Captain Kumar's wealthy reserves fill Chandan, his lookalike, with jealousy. In order to fulfil his greed, he decides to take Kumar's place by pretending to be him.

title: Jungle Love Story
desc: Vowing to exact revenge on her father's killer, a woman walks into the dangerous, uncharted jungle. Soon after, she coincidentally meets the powerful jungle king.

title: Filhaal
desc: When Sia watches her best friend Rewa slip into depression because of her inability to bear a child, she offers to be her surrogate. Trouble brews when jealousy finds its way into their relationship.

title: Apna Bana Lo
desc: A gangster adopts a boy nicknamed Master and teaches him the criminal lifestyle. As Master grows up, he reaches a pivotal moment and decides to abandon his life of crime.

title: Ittefaq
desc: Dilip, a young painter, is sent to a psychiatric institute after allegedly murdering his wife. However, things become complicated when he escapes and stumbles onto another crime scene.
